title.en: Circular-filament vacuum field on a cylindrical grid
title.zh: 柱坐标网格上的圆电流丝真空场

summary: Evaluate ideal circular-filament fields on a uniform rectilinear R,Z grid and integrate radial flux from the first radial node.

capability: Circular-filament vacuum field on a cylindrical grid
Evaluate ideal circular-filament fields on a uniform rectilinear R-Z grid and integrate radial flux from the first radial node.
operation: filament vacuum-field evaluation with radial flux integration
grid coordinates and filament currents -> psi, BR and BZ grids
discovery.model: Ideal circular-filament vacuum field with no near-axis cutoff.
discovery.geometry: Rectilinear grid with the radial coordinate varying along exactly one array axis.
discovery.boundary: The first radial node is the psi reference and the axis radial field is zero; source-target coincidence remains singular.

identity.relation: Filament vacuum field and radial flux integration
identity.direction: grid coordinates and filament currents to psi, BR, and BZ grids
identity.definition: Evaluate the Green kernel at grid points and integrate R*BZ with a radial trapezoid recurrence.
identity.model: Ideal circular-filament vacuum field with no near-axis cutoff.
identity.geometry: Rectilinear grid with the radial coordinate varying along exactly one array axis.
identity.coordinates: R,Z in metres; filament current in amperes; psi Wb/rad; fields tesla.
identity.boundary: The first radial node is the psi reference and axis radial field is zero; source-target coincidence remains singular.
assumptions: The radial axis is nonnegative, strictly increasing, and uniformly spaced.
No 2pi factor is applied to psi.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.shape: 2-D, at least two points per axis
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonnegative, rectilinear, uniformly spaced and strictly increasing along exactly one array axis.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Finite and rectilinear along the other axis; axial order is not constrained.

inputs.name: filaments
inputs.description: Ideal circular source rows [R0_m, Z0_m, current_A].
inputs.constraints: Finite with strictly positive source radius; an empty source set is allowed; no source may coincide with a target grid point.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Psi=R A_phi from radial trapezoidal integration of R times B_Z, referenced to the first radial grid point.
outputs.constraints: Zero at the first radial grid point; no 2*pi factor is applied.

outputs.name: b_r
outputs.constraints: Zero on the cylindrical axis R=0 under the Green-kernel axis limit.

preconditions: The radial axis is nonnegative, strictly increasing, and uniformly spaced.
supported: Transposed rectilinear layouts, superposition, analytic axis BZ, and radial trapezoid recurrence.
excluded: Nonrectilinear grids, finite-wire self-fields, and continuum convergence claims.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for malformed grids, nonfinite values, invalid axes, or source/target singularity.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError is raised for a nonfinite Green or integrated result.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; kernel evaluation and quadrature are direct.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No field mapping is returned after validation or arithmetic failure.

example.description: Evaluate one off-grid filament on a 4x5 rectilinear grid.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.field.filament_vacuum_field import integrate_filament_vacuum_field
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0.0, 0.3, 5), np.linspace(-0.2, 0.2, 4))
result = integrate_filament_vacuum_field(r_grid, z_grid, [[0.45, -0.1, 1500.0]])
assert set(result) == {'psi', 'b_r', 'b_z'}
assert all(value.shape == r_grid.shape for value in result.values())
assert np.isfinite(result['b_z']).all()
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result['psi'][:, 0], 0.0)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result['b_r'][:, 0], 0.0)
example.expected: All returned arrays have shape (4,5), psi and BR are zero on the first radial column, and BZ is finite.

scope: Radial quadrature increment and first-grid-point reference.
Comparison with independent circular-filament psi=R A_phi Green values away from the source.
Transposed rectilinear layout and invalid radial grid.
独立70/80位精度理想圆环关系核对极小正半径、近轴非零BR、近丝和公式求值分支，保持原数值断言与容差；精确离散自项与算术失败分别处理。
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct regressions cover selected ideal-filament superposition, axial field, radial quadrature and a fine-grid comparison with the circular-filament psi kernel after subtracting the first-radius reference. They do not establish arbitrary-grid quadrature accuracy, complete source-project closure or expert approval.
known_limitations: The returned flux uses the first radial grid point as reference and omits a 2-pi flux factor.
The ideal source is singular at coincident targets, which are rejected.
Public distribution licensing remains pending a human decision.
psi的径向梯形误差需由网格加密验证；即便磁场按解析关系计算，离散psi也不宣称等于解析RAphi。
